cat <<'PY' > tests/test_stock.py
import pytest

from inventory.stock import Stock, parse_qty


def test_parse_qty():
    assert parse_qty(" 12 ") == 12


def test_parse_qty_rejects_text():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        parse_qty("twelve")


@pytest.mark.parametrize("text", ["0", "-3"])
def test_parse_qty_rejects_non_positive(text):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        parse_qty(text)


def test_add_and_remove():
    s = Stock()
    s.add("widget", 5)
    s.remove("widget", 2)
    assert s.level("widget") == 3


def test_remove_too_many():
    s = Stock()
    s.add("gadget", 1)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        s.remove("gadget", 2)
PY
python3 -m pytest -q
